misconceptions.description: Publishing a GitHub Pages site whose homepage is not named index.html, so the root URL shows a 404
misconceptions.trigger: learner names the homepage home.html and the site root returns Not Found
misconceptions.feedback: Name the homepage index.html at the repo root (or /docs). GitHub Pages serves index.html as the default page.

misconceptions.description: Linking to files with a local absolute path like C:/Users/... instead of a relative path inside the repo
misconceptions.trigger: an image tag points to C:/Users/me/pic.png and shows broken on the live site
misconceptions.feedback: Use repository-relative paths such as ./images/pic.png. A C:/Users path only works on your computer, not on the web.

misconceptions.description: Pushing files but never selecting a Pages source branch and folder, so nothing is published
misconceptions.trigger: learner pushes to main but Settings > Pages source is still 'None'
misconceptions.feedback: In Settings > Pages, set the source to the branch (main) and folder (root or /docs). Pushing alone does not enable publishing.

misconceptions.description: Leaving an HTML tag unclosed or mis-nested so the page renders incorrectly
misconceptions.trigger:
learner opens
    with list items but never writes
and the layout breaks
misconceptions.feedback: Close every tag you open and keep nesting correct. Validate the markup so the page renders as intended.
